Delivering stronger returns
CFE Grain
All local locations— Clifford, Galesburg, Hope, Hunter, and Gardner —will be offering a Free Price Later Program on soybeans
Any soybeans delivered under this program must be priced by March 25, 2027 .
2026 Wheat & Corn Program:
Wheat, Corn &: Price Later fee is $0.05 per month , beginning 15 days after delivery . Beginning of day 16, storage charges will apply retroactively back to day 1.
For wheat, market premiums and discounts apply at the time of delivery.
Locations included, Clifford, Galesburg, Hope, Hunter, Gardner and Casselton.
Getting you more for your grain
Grain markets can be volatile, so having a solid marketing plan in place goes a long way in maximizing success and profitability. It’s in our best interest to get you the highest possible price for your grain. Our merchandisers are in the market every day, and you can rely on them to bring their years of grain marketing experience to bear on your behalf.   
With five locations in east-central North Dakota, there are plenty of options for storing, selling, and taking payment for your grain. We offer competitive pricing for grain contracts, including:
Basis
Hedge-to-arrive
Price-later
Deferred payment
Many of our locations are open extra hours during harvest season to keep local combines rolling, while offering limited grain hauling services as well.
Contact one of our merchandisers for more information.
“We first got exposure to Clifford by selling corn to the ethanol plant through their location at Casselton. We saw how attractive their patronage payments were, so we have gradually done more and more business with them.”
— Joe Morken, Amenia, ND.
Clifford member for more than 5 years.
Receiving Schedules
We’re always set up for deliveries of wheat, soybeans, and corn. Please call for other crops to make delivery arrangements.
We run extra hours during harvest, but it’s a good idea to call outside of harvest to check on delivery hours.
